name: AI Usage Meter for Claude & Codex
description:
Shows your Claude Code or ChatGPT/Codex subscription usage (5-hour session and weekly limits) as two small bars in the top bar.

Privacy: the extension reads the login token that the Claude Code CLI (~/.claude/.credentials.json) or Codex CLI (~/.codex/auth.json) already stored, and sends it only to Anthropic (api.anthropic.com) or OpenAI (chatgpt.com) to fetch your usage. It never modifies or copies those files and sends nothing anywhere else.

Unofficial; not affiliated with Anthropic or OpenAI.
